snippet.title: Expendabots - Announcement Trailer - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A World Premiere Announcement Trailer for Expendabots. Expendabots is a co-op extraction title in which you play as robots with 3d printers installed on their bodies. Use these to construct items to help you upgrade and survive against unknown and terrifying monstrosities.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
